intro.title: Experts
intro.body: A quick walkthrough: chat list, conversation, header and settings, composer. Use arrow buttons or Next; close anytime (Escape or the dimmed backdrop).

sidebar.title: Chat list
sidebar.body: “New” opens the hero or group picker. Search narrows the list. Pin keeps chats at hand. Double-click the title to rename.

thread.title: Conversation
thread.body: Messages support markdown, copy actions, and optional reply regeneration. The header avatar opens the “About this assistant” card.

header.title: Header actions
header.body: The label shows who is speaking (hero or group). Chevron collapses settings. Download exports history as Markdown; trash deletes this chat.

settings.title: Chat settings
settings.body: Use the toggles below for voice, smart actions, and web search. Open Advanced for project link, project memory, and group document mode.

composer.title: Message input
composer.body: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Drop files on the chat or use Attach. The mic works after you enable Voice input in settings; Stop halts generation, Send posts your message.
composer.bodyVoiceOff: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line. Drop files on the chat or use Attach. Stop halts generation, Send posts your message.

outro.title: You’re set
outro.body: Reopen the tour anytime via the sparkles button in the header.
